snippet.title: Bear Mage Honey Sage - Release Trailer [XB1 | XBX | MS Store]
snippet.description:
Microsoft Store: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/bear-mage-honey-sage-windows/9N5ZXSVBJQPJ
Xbox One: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/bear-mage-honey-sage/9NMX29F9D4ZB
Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/bear-mage-honey-sage-xbox-series/9N2P60M3FZJK

Bear Mage Honey Sage is a fun mashup of puzzle and action-platformer, craft magical honey blocks to build your own path through each stage! These blocks stick to any surface they touch, turning into safe platforms for the wise Bear Wizard to leap across. Help him journey through the dangerous yet beautiful magical forest in his quest for more honey to power his spells!

The wizard is as clever as he is agile! Combine honey block launching with double jumps to reach any height and grab even the trickiest honeycombs. Conquer 10 varied stages packed with challenges that test both your problem-solving and your platforming skills!
